title: Tate-coordinate series converge in an algebraic normed extension
statement: Let F be a complete normed field and Ω a normed field equipped with a NormedAlgebra F Ω structure and algebraic over F. Assume the norm of Ω satisfies ‖x+y‖ ≤ max(‖x‖,‖y‖). Let q ∈ F satisfy 0 < ‖q‖ < 1, and put Q = algebraMap F Ω q. For every unit u ∈ Ωˣ such that u ≠ Q^m for every integer m, both ℤ-indexed families Q^n u/(1−Q^n u)^2 and (Q^n u)^2/(1−Q^n u)^3 are summable in Ω. Completeness of Ω is not assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (F Ω : Type) [NormedField F] [CompleteSpace F] [NormedField Ω] [NormedAlgebra F Ω] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F Ω], (∀ x y : Ω, ‖x + y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖) → ∀ q : F, 0 < ‖q‖ → ‖q‖ < 1 → let qΩ : Ω := algebraMap F Ω q; ∀ u : Ωˣ, (¬ ∃ m : ℤ, (u : Ω) = qΩ ^ m) → Summable (fun n : ℤ => qΩ ^ n * (u : Ω) / (1 - qΩ ^ n * (u : Ω)) ^ 2) ∧ Summable (fun n : ℤ => (qΩ ^ n * (u : Ω)) ^ 2 / (1 - qΩ ^ n * (u : Ω)) ^ 3)
